title: Cloud Basics — Sample Set
description: A short sample set showing single, multiple and true/false questions.
author: Practice Test App

questions.prompt: Which storage type is best suited to serving static website files?
questions.explanation: Object storage is designed for large numbers of independent files served over HTTP.

options.explanation: Correct — objects are addressed by key and served directly over HTTP.
Block storage attaches to one machine and has no HTTP interface of its own.
Archive storage trades retrieval latency for cost — wrong for live pages.

questions.prompt: Which two of these operate at the network layer?
questions.explanation: Routers and subnets are layer-3 concepts; the others are not.

options.explanation: Correct — routers forward packets between networks.
Correct — a subnet is a layer-3 address range.
TLS lives far above the network layer.

questions.prompt: A public IP address is required for two machines in the same private subnet to talk to each other.
questions.explanation: Machines in the same subnet reach each other on private addresses.
